# Generated by Claude outputs/COLDWAR_EC_generator/build.py - do not edit by hand.

# Any scope. The Community budget (design 9): contributions = call rate x GDP; farm pool by farm districts, regional pool by gap below 90 % of the average GDP per head, research and other by GDP share, administration to Brussels and Luxembourg; programmes abroad and projects by GDP share; balances sum to zero inside the Community.
COLDWAR_EC_budget_recompute = {
	# 1. totals of the members
	set_variable = { global.cwec_bg_gdp = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_bg_dist = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_bg_pop = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwec_bg_gdp = gdp_total }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwec_bg_dist = agriculture_district_total }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwec_bg_pop = population_total_m }
		}
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_bg_gdp min = 0.001 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_bg_dist min = 0.001 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_bg_pop min = 0.001 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_bg_avg = global.cwec_bg_gdp }
	divide_variable = { global.cwec_bg_avg = global.cwec_bg_pop }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_thr = global.cwec_bg_avg }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_thr = 0.9 }
	# 2. regional recipients: GDP per head below 90 % of the Community average, weighted by gap and population
	set_variable = { global.cwec_bg_gap = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_regional
			set_variable = { cwec_gapw = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { gdp_per_capita < cwec_t_thr } }
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_regional
				set_variable = { cwec_gapw = cwec_t_thr }
				subtract_from_variable = { cwec_gapw = gdp_per_capita }
				multiply_variable = { cwec_gapw = population_total_m }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_bg_gap = cwec_gapw }
			}
		}
	}
	# 3. contributions at the call rate (new members pay half for five years)
	set_variable = { global.cwec_bg_R = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_variable = { cwec_bg_c = gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_bg_c = global.cwec_callrate }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_bg_c = 0.01 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_transition }
				multiply_variable = { cwec_bg_c = 0.5 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { global.cwec_bg_R = cwec_bg_c }
		}
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_bg_R min = 0.001 }
	# 4. spending pools; provisional twelfths halve regional and research spending
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_tw = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_twelfths }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_tw = 0.5 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_agri = global.cwec_bg_R }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_agri = global.cwec_sh_agri }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_agri = 0.01 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_reg = global.cwec_bg_R }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_reg = global.cwec_sh_reg }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_reg = 0.01 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_res = global.cwec_bg_R }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_res = global.cwec_sh_res }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_res = 0.01 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_adm = global.cwec_bg_R }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_adm = global.cwec_sh_adm }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_adm = 0.01 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_oth = global.cwec_bg_R }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_oth = global.cwec_sh_oth }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_oth = 0.01 }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_reg = cwec_t_tw }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_res = cwec_t_tw }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_bg_gap = 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_oth = global.cwec_bg_p_reg }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_reg = 0 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bel = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lux = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = BEL
			BEL = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bel = 0.7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = LUX
			LUX = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lux = 0.3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bel = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwec_t_lux > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lux = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_lux = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwec_t_bel > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bel = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bel = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwec_t_lux = 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_oth = global.cwec_bg_p_adm }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_bg_p_adm = 0 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_bg_S = global.cwec_bg_p_agri }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_bg_S = global.cwec_bg_p_reg }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_bg_S = global.cwec_bg_p_res }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_bg_S = global.cwec_bg_p_adm }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_bg_S = global.cwec_bg_p_oth }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_f = global.cwec_bg_S }
	divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_f = global.cwec_bg_R }
	# 5. external spending: Community programmes abroad and joint projects (annual)
	set_variable = { global.cwec_bg_X = global.cwec_aid_cost_month }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwec_bg_X = 12 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_bg_X = global.cwec_proj_annual }
	# 6. every member: payments and receipts
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_gs = gdp_total }
			divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_gs = global.cwec_bg_gdp }
			set_variable = { cwec_bg_pay = cwec_bg_c }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_bg_pay = cwec_t_f }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = global.cwec_bg_X }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_t_gs }
			add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_pay = cwec_t_x }
			add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_pay = cwec_host_extra }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_run_airbus
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_airbus }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = gdp_total }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = 0.001 }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_pay = cwec_t_x }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_run_ariane
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_ariane }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = gdp_total }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = 0.0008 }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_pay = cwec_t_x }
			}
			# farm pool by share of farm districts
			set_variable = { cwec_bg_recv = agriculture_district_total }
			divide_variable = { cwec_bg_recv = global.cwec_bg_dist }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_bg_recv = global.cwec_bg_p_agri }
			# research and other pools by GDP share
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = global.cwec_bg_p_res }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = global.cwec_bg_p_oth }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_t_gs }
			add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_recv = cwec_t_x }
			# regional pool by gap
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_regional
					check_variable = { global.cwec_bg_gap > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_gapw }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = global.cwec_bg_gap }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = global.cwec_bg_p_reg }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_recv = cwec_t_x }
			}
			# administration in the seat countries
			if = {
				limit = { original_tag = BEL }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = global.cwec_bg_p_adm }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_t_bel }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_recv = cwec_t_x }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { original_tag = LUX }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = global.cwec_bg_p_adm }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_t_lux }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_recv = cwec_t_x }
			}
		}
	}
	# 7. budget correction for one net payer (Fontainebleau): two thirds of its net contribution back
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_rebate > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_rb = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_gp = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:global.cwec_rebate = { exists = yes COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } var:global.cwec_rebate = { set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_rb = cwec_bg_pay } subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_rb = cwec_bg_recv } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_rb > 0 } }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_rb = 0.66 }
			var:global.cwec_rebate = { add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_recv = cwec_t_rb } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_rebate } }
							check_variable = { cwec_bg_pay > cwec_bg_recv } }
						add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_gp = gdp_total }
					}
				}
			}
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_gp min = 0.001 }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_rebate } }
							check_variable = { cwec_bg_pay > cwec_bg_recv } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = gdp_total }
						divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_t_gp }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_t_rb }
						add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_pay = cwec_t_x }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# 8. Community loans: repayments with interest to the lenders
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_l1_target > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_ly = global.cwec_l1_weekly }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_ly = 52 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lg = global.cwec_bg_gdp }
		if = { limit = { var:global.cwec_l1_target = { exists = yes } } var:global.cwec_l1_target = { subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lg = gdp_total } add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_pay = cwec_t_ly } } }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_lg min = 0.001 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_l1_target } } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = gdp_total }
					divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_t_lg }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_t_ly }
					add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_recv = cwec_t_x }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_l2_target > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_ly = global.cwec_l2_weekly }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_ly = 52 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lg = global.cwec_bg_gdp }
		if = { limit = { var:global.cwec_l2_target = { exists = yes } } var:global.cwec_l2_target = { subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lg = gdp_total } add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_pay = cwec_t_ly } } }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_lg min = 0.001 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_l2_target } } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = gdp_total }
					divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_t_lg }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_t_ly }
					add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_recv = cwec_t_x }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# 9. remittances of guest workers (assistance return)
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_ext
		if = { limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } set_variable = { cwec_bg_pay = 0 } set_variable = { cwec_bg_recv = 0 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_target > 0 }
			check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_remit > 0 } }
		if = { limit = { var:global.cwec_h1_by = { exists = yes } } var:global.cwec_h1_by = { add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_pay = global.cwec_h1_remit } } }
		if = { limit = { var:global.cwec_h1_target = { exists = yes } } var:global.cwec_h1_target = { add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_recv = global.cwec_h1_remit } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_target > 0 }
			check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_remit > 0 } }
		if = { limit = { var:global.cwec_h2_by = { exists = yes } } var:global.cwec_h2_by = { add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_pay = global.cwec_h2_remit } } }
		if = { limit = { var:global.cwec_h2_target = { exists = yes } } var:global.cwec_h2_target = { add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_recv = global.cwec_h2_remit } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_target > 0 }
			check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_remit > 0 } }
		if = { limit = { var:global.cwec_h3_by = { exists = yes } } var:global.cwec_h3_by = { add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_pay = global.cwec_h3_remit } } }
		if = { limit = { var:global.cwec_h3_target = { exists = yes } } var:global.cwec_h3_target = { add_to_variable = { cwec_bg_recv = global.cwec_h3_remit } } }
	}
	# 10. weekly values for the MD money system, net in $M per week, flags
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_variable = { cwec_wk_pay = cwec_bg_pay }
			divide_variable = { cwec_wk_pay = 52 }
			set_variable = { cwec_wk_recv = cwec_bg_recv }
			divide_variable = { cwec_wk_recv = 52 }
			set_variable = { cwec_net = cwec_bg_recv }
			subtract_from_variable = { cwec_net = cwec_bg_pay }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_net = 19.231 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_net < 0 } }
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_net_payer
			}
			else = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_net_payer
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_bg_pay }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_bg_recv }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_y = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_y = 0.003 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_x > cwec_t_y } }
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_big_payer
			}
			else = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_big_payer
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = agriculture_district_total }
			divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = global.cwec_bg_dist }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_y = gdp_total }
			divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_y = global.cwec_bg_gdp }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_x > cwec_t_y } }
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_agrarian
			}
			else = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_agrarian
			}
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_ext
		if = { limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } }
			set_variable = { cwec_wk_pay = cwec_bg_pay }
			divide_variable = { cwec_wk_pay = 52 }
			set_variable = { cwec_wk_recv = cwec_bg_recv }
			divide_variable = { cwec_wk_recv = 52 }
		}
	}
	# 11. who pays whom: three largest net payers and recipients
	COLDWAR_EC_rank_balances = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_bg_rate_shown = global.cwec_callrate }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Who pays whom: the five largest net payers and net recipients.
COLDWAR_EC_rank_balances = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_net < cwec_t_best }  }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = cwec_net }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_pay1 = cwec_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_pay1_v = cwec_t_best }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_net > cwec_t_best }  }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = cwec_net }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_rec1 = cwec_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_rec1_v = cwec_t_best }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_net < cwec_t_best } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_pay1 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = cwec_net }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_pay2 = cwec_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_pay2_v = cwec_t_best }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_net > cwec_t_best } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_rec1 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = cwec_net }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_rec2 = cwec_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_rec2_v = cwec_t_best }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_net < cwec_t_best } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_pay1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_pay2 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = cwec_net }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_pay3 = cwec_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_pay3_v = cwec_t_best }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_net > cwec_t_best } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_rec1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_rec2 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = cwec_net }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_rec3 = cwec_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_rec3_v = cwec_t_best }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_net < cwec_t_best } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_pay1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_pay2 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_pay3 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = cwec_net }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_pay4 = cwec_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_pay4_v = cwec_t_best }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_net > cwec_t_best } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_rec1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_rec2 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_rec3 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = cwec_net }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_rec4 = cwec_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_rec4_v = cwec_t_best }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_net < cwec_t_best } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_pay1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_pay2 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_pay3 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_pay4 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = cwec_net }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_pay5 = cwec_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_pay5_v = cwec_t_best }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_net > cwec_t_best } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_rec1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_rec2 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_rec3 } } NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_top_rec4 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = cwec_net }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_rec5 = cwec_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_top_rec5_v = cwec_t_best }
}

# Any scope. Every October the Council votes the annual budget; without players it is carried over.
COLDWAR_EC_open_budget = {
	COLDWAR_EC_next_oct1 = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_budget_next = cwec_t_next }
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_EC_any_player_member = yes
			check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_item = 130 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_stage = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_by = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_target = 0 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_issue = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_issue = global.cwec_issue }
		COLDWAR_EC_s9_to_queue = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_EC_budget_adopted = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Annual budget adopted.
COLDWAR_EC_budget_adopted = {
	clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_twelfths
	COLDWAR_EC_budget_recompute = yes
}

# Any scope. Budget rejected: provisional twelfths for a year (regional and research spending halved), support -2.
COLDWAR_EC_budget_rejected = {
	set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_twelfths days = 365 value = 1 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = -2 }
			COLDWAR_EC_push_support = yes
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_budget_recompute = yes
}

# Any scope. Community loan (Reg. 397/75): the borrower in the context receives 1.5 % of its GDP, the other members lend by GDP share; repayment over five years with 2 % interest.
COLDWAR_EC_start_loan = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target > 0 }
			var:global.cwec_ctx_target = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwec_ctx_target = { set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_amt = gdp_total } multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_amt = 0.015 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_done = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_l1_target = 0 }
				check_variable = { cwec_t_done = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_done = 1 }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_l1_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_l1_amount = cwec_t_amt }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_l1_weekly = cwec_t_amt }
			multiply_variable = { global.cwec_l1_weekly = 0.00423 }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_l1_end = global.num_days }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwec_l1_end = 1820 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_l2_target = 0 }
				check_variable = { cwec_t_done = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_done = 1 }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_l2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_l2_amount = cwec_t_amt }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_l2_weekly = cwec_t_amt }
			multiply_variable = { global.cwec_l2_weekly = 0.00423 }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_l2_end = global.num_days }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwec_l2_end = 1820 }
		}
		# paid only when a loan slot was free (two loans at most)
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_done = 1 } }
			var:global.cwec_ctx_target = { set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwec_t_amt } modify_treasury_effect = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lg = global.cwec_bg_gdp }
			var:global.cwec_ctx_target = { subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lg = gdp_total } }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_lg min = 0.001 }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_ctx_target } } }
						set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
						divide_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwec_t_lg }
						multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwec_t_amt }
						multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
						modify_treasury_effect = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Repaid loans close.
COLDWAR_EC_loans_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_l1_target > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_l1_end } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_l1_target = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_l1_weekly = 0 }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_budget_dirty
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_l2_target > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_l2_end } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_l2_target = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_l2_weekly = 0 }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_budget_dirty
	}
}
